prompt_extra:
- Plain JSX, no wrapper component. Include <AuthorBox /> with NO props near the end.
- AuthorBox accepts no props at all.
- Facts about this site (do not contradict): QR codes are NOT all static. URL and PDF codes can be made dynamic for free and their destination is edited later in My QR Codes (/dashboard) without reprinting; dynamic codes do not expire. WiFi, vCard, Email and Text codes are always static.
- The site has ONE generator. It has no scheduled updates, no API, no accounts and no edit links.
